title: Workspace panel rendering and interaction
description: Measure a substantial workspace panel as separate, per-action intervals: cold-surface shell opening, opening and closing toggle pairs, warm-data reopening, surface and file navigation, and settled diff controls. Toggle pairs are animated reversals when a transition exists and immediate double-toggles otherwise. Network/data readiness remains a milestone rather than being folded into shell animation.

metrics.description: One trusted panel action to its action-specific painted and interactive endpoint.
Raw renderer frame timestamps are converted by the framework into per-action worst and p95 frame intervals and counts above the 16.667 ms 60 Hz budget.
Per-action renderer task, script, style-recalculation, and layout work, with bounded raw long-animation-frame attribution.
